description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). Reads metadata fields: tool_count, has_description, description_length, schema_complete_count, registry_source, has_examples. Computes tool description safety score by penalizing incomplete schemas, missing descriptions, and suspiciously high tool counts while rewarding well-documented tool surfaces. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Returns evidence dict with per-field partial scores.
